note: Transitional: transitional B cells — small dense cluster at the upper-right (CD38 high, CD24 high), well separated above the broader CD24-mid CD38-mid bulk; the rest is unassigned.
tips: Transitional B-cell identification (independent of the IgD/CD27 axis used at Step 3 — parallel annotation on the same parent). Transitional: CD38hi CD24hi. Overlap caveat: transitional B cells are IgD+ CD27-, so they also fall into the `Naive` bin at Step 3 — Step 3 and Step 4 produce overlapping labels on the same cells by design, not as an artifact (downstream analyses that need a Naive-without-Transitional pool should compute `Naive AND NOT Transitional` via boolean operation). Useful co-markers: IgM is typically high on transitional B but is not in this panel.
